name: Rucha Jayant Pande
bio: Rucha Pande is the Founder and Director of CoLab Global. Prior to this, she was the Chief Operating Officer at Mantra4Change since April 2021 and headed the Design team at the organization since 2017. A graduate of MA in Education from the Azim Premji University and the Genpact Social Impact Fellowship, Rucha specializes in designing for scale. She aspires to nurture civil society organizations in the global south to develop high-quality, impact-driven programs that leverage and contribute to evidence in the social sector.

name: Akhil S Kashinath
bio: Akhil has over eight years of experience in business development and operations, working across both early-stage ventures and social impact initiatives. As a former entrepreneur and Teach For India Fellow, he brings a deep commitment to strengthening the role of evidence in the development sector. Akhil supports strategic partnerships & financial vertical at CoLab. He focuses on building relationships that help mission-driven projects grow sustainably. His cross-sector experience allows him to bridge both business and social impact perspectives, contributing to CoLab’s effort to build collaboration.

name: Harikrishnan H
bio: An experienced education professional committed to advancing educational equity through research-driven and innovative solutions. With deep expertise in program design, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), and program evaluation, he has developed and implemented data-driven initiatives aimed at improving educational outcomes. As a former Teach for India fellow, he demonstrated a strong commitment to educational equity by providing holistic support to students. He continues to lead efforts that leverage technology, research, and evidence-based practices to create more inclusive and effective learning environments, always striving to enhance the impact of educational programs.

name: Athira Ashokan
bio: Athira is a skilled education and content strategist with a robust background in designing and leading impactful projects across India. With over 5+ years of diverse experience in the development sector, she has demonstrated exceptional skills in content creation, operations, M&E, and project management. She began her journey as a teacher, developing a strong foundation in educational pedagogy. Later, she transitioned into the role of a facilitator and content specialist where she built on her foundational skills with the understanding of creating safe learning spaces in a classroom for teachers and students. Stepping into leadership roles helped her excel in strategizing and monitoring training programs, effectively managing teams, and collaborating with varied stakeholders. Athira also played a pivotal role in a large-scale COVID response project, converting textbooks into televised episodes across Maharashtra & Goa to ensure uninterrupted learning during the pandemic.

name: Ann Catharin Antony
bio: Ann is passionate about driving equitable access to education for all children and catalyzing positive societal transformation. A graduate from the University of Manchester with a Masters in Public Policy and Management. Her involvement in qualitative and quantitative research projects has honed her research acumen, and her experience in curriculum design and student projects underscores her passion for education. Ann was a Teach For India fellow, bringing in transformative impacts in the classroom. Her dedication extends to her work with multiple NGOs, where she has contributed to program design and various campaigns aimed at improving educational outcomes. With a deep commitment to her cause, Ann continues to strive for a more inclusive and equitable future for all children.

name: Sumedha Mohanty
bio: Sumedha is a highly committed professional focused on driving evidence-based advancements in both the education sector and food security. With a foundation in development studies, she has built extensive experience in designing and implementing impact evaluations, performing detailed diagnostics, and creating data collection tools tailored for research and evaluation. Her expertise spans the intricacies of educational systems and food safety challenges, where she leverages data-driven insights to influence decisions and drive long-term, positive change. Her work is grounded in a deep understanding of the socio-economic factors that affect these critical sectors.

name: Mrinalini Aditya Murthy
bio: Mrinalini deeply believes in evidence-informed systemic transformation. With a Bachelor’s degree in Sociology from the Manipal Center for Humanities, she comes with deep theoretical knowledge of global and domestic social structures. She is a skilled researcher adept at designing and executing sophisticated research projects. Having been in the social consulting space over the course of the year, she brings with her a good practical understanding of the challenges and opportunities in the development sector. She deeply believes in 3 C’s: creativity, compassion, and collaboration, which are integral to bringing sustainable shifts in the ecosystem. She is passionate about nurturing the Indian education system, and transforming the lives of children one project at a time.

name: Swathi Gangadhar
bio: Swathi is a social researcher and human-centred designer passionate about creating equitable systems through inclusive strategies. With an interdisciplinary background spanning design, and research, she brings a holistic lens to projects that advance equity, accessibility, and community well-being, having practiced research and co-design to translate insights into actionable solutions. A graduate of the Maryland Institute College of Art with a Masters in Social Design, she aspires to nurture spaces where diverse voices shape solutions, and to contribute to systemic change that strengthens communities and fosters belonging.

name: Syed Wasim
bio: With over a decade of experience spanning education, public policy, and recently venture capital, Wasim specializes in strengthening large-scale governance and social impact systems. A former Teach For India Fellow and an alumnus of the Indian School of Business, he brings a deeply grounded perspective to driving systemic change. This commitment to large-scale impact was heavily shaped during his tenure leading state programs for Punjab and Odisha at Mantra4Change, where he navigated complex government machinery and built the strategic bureaucratic partnerships required to transform public schooling. Today, as the Director of Strategy & Partnerships at CoLab, Wasim channels this multi-sector expertise into a diverse portfolio of consulting engagements. Whether he is designing scalable education models, managing entrepreneurship development programs, or guiding investment pipelines, his strength lies in bridging the gap between grassroots implementation and high-level policy.
